mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS shows a 3-month average increase of > 200k jobs, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.05 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds its 6-month moving average, signaling increased housing demand, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days due to the housing market's multiplier effect on the broader economy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL shows a 2-month average increase < 0.5%, signaling accommodative monetary policy without inflation pressures, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below its 3-month moving average, signaling improved labor market conditions, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in RSAFS, indicating rising retail sales, boosts corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 4-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of RSAFS growth (t-test p > 0.05).
